sections.html: This characin species will probably not grow much larger than 6 cm. They are friendly and lively schooling fish, very suitable for a community tank. These fish are not difficult to keep and will tolerate all types of water.
This very attractive tetra originates from the Rio Madeira, which runs into the Amazon River downstream from Manaus in Brazil.

As with all representatives of the genus Hyphessobrycon, these fish will thrive in a well-planted aquarium with many small-leaved plants, but also enough room for swimming. They also prefer a dark-coloured substrate. They are ideal inhabitants for a so-called Dutch aquarium and will show their best colours under soft lighting.
